text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their direct message. Moss's notes mention two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's 5 Oct 2025 "Sunday prep for Ruth" note. Drivers at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. Support patched it on 4 Oct and Thea Ramaswell (the customer's yard operations contact) confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated "North cheat sheet". It covers barcode scanners at Door 14 that weren't reading trailer tags, and says the ticket was escalated to tier-2 support.

I also warned Dana that #4419 may be wrong. In a handoff note dated 14 Jul 2025, Marcus uses the same number for a different problem (slow printing at Gate 3). The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell which description is right, and I suggested they check the ticket system before using it.

Moss's other two notes on this customer don't have any ticket numbers. All of Moss's notes are public files on the team share, so Dana can see everything I used.
